name.pt: Últimas notas de personagem em Carnac (6)

hint.en: Talk to these six before talking to Karja at the pier, or the all-notes trophy is lost. A bonus Runestone scene waits in the Lighthouse depths, by the west wall.
hint.pt: Fale com estes seis antes de falar com a Karja no píer, ou o troféu de todas as notas se perde. Uma cena bônus de Runestone espera no fundo do farol, junto à parede oeste.

sources: guide: Neoseeker Ys X walkthrough, Epilogue
guide: GameFAQs Ys X walkthrough, Epilogue

text.en: Gunnar — near the Lighthouse entrance (Haagen Highway)
text.pt: Gunnar — perto da entrada do farol (Haagen Highway)
